sections.title: Miami Industry Specializations
sections.description: Deep expertise in Miami's key industry verticals.

blocks.heading: Financial Services (Miami's Emerging Finance Hub)
paragraphs: Miami's financial community has grown explosively — Citadel (Ken Griffin relocated Citadel and Citadel Securities from Chicago to Miami), Icahn Enterprises (Miami Beach HQ), and dozens of hedge funds, family offices, and financial technology companies that have followed the migration from New York and Chicago:
Hedge fund and quantitative AI: ML for Citadel's quantitative trading ecosystem and the emerging Miami hedge fund community — factor research, execution analytics, and portfolio risk management.

Wealth management for Miami's HNW community: AI for the family offices and private wealth managers serving Miami's extraordinary concentration of high-net-worth individuals — international wealth, real estate wealth, and private equity wealth that makes Miami's HNW density among the highest in the US.

Latin America cross-border finance: ML for the international banking and financial services connecting Miami to Latin American markets — cross-border payment analytics, FX risk, and Latin American credit assessment.
Cost: $45,000–$130,000 | Timeline: 10–22 weeks | SEC/FINRA, FinCEN context

blocks.heading: Healthcare
paragraphs: Jackson Health System (Miami HQ, Miami-Dade's public hospital system and one of the US's largest public hospital systems), University of Miami Health System (UHealth), and Baptist Health South Florida:
HIPAA-compliant clinical AI for Miami's academic and public health systems.
Multilingual clinical AI for Miami's diverse patient population — Spanish-English bilingual AI is essential in a city where Spanish is the primary business language for significant segments.
Florida Medicaid analytics for Jackson Health's large safety-net patient population.
Cost: $50,000–$135,000 | Timeline: 12–22 weeks | HIPAA + Spanish language

blocks.heading: Latin America Gateway Technology
paragraphs: Miami is the undisputed US headquarters for Latin American businesses — hundreds of multinational companies use Miami as their Americas hub:
Multilingual document AI: Spanish-English-Portuguese document processing for Miami's Latin American corporate community — a capability that US-only AI companies rarely provide at production quality.
Cross-border compliance: AI for the complex regulatory compliance of US-Latin America cross-border operations — OFAC, FinCEN, and Latin American regulatory monitoring.
Regional market analytics: ML for the Latin American consumer and business markets that Miami's regional headquarters community analyzes daily.
Cost: $35,000–$100,000 | Timeline: 10–20 weeks | Multilingual + FinCEN

blocks.heading: Real Estate (South Florida's Active Market)
paragraphs: Miami's luxury real estate, Brickell's commercial development, and South Florida's active residential market:
Miami AVM: Automated valuation models for Miami's complex market — luxury waterfront single-family, Brickell high-rise condominiums, and Miami Beach's trophy properties.

Foreign buyer analytics: ML incorporating the international buyer dimension of Miami's unique real estate market — buyers from Latin America, Europe, and the Middle East whose impact on Miami's market differs from domestic buyers.
Commercial real estate analytics: ML for Brickell's office, retail, and mixed-use development cycle.
Cost: $45,000–$125,000 | Timeline: 10–22 weeks

sections.title: Miami AI Regulatory Context
sections.description: Key legal and compliance considerations for Miami AI development.

blocks.heading: Florida Digital Bill of Rights
paragraphs: Florida's consumer privacy law applies to Miami's consumer-facing AI — ClickMasters designs Miami AI with FDBR compliance.

blocks.heading: FinCEN and international banking
paragraphs: Miami's international banking community creates heightened FinCEN and BSA compliance requirements — ClickMasters designs Miami financial AI with anti-money laundering and international transaction monitoring context.

blocks.heading: Multilingual legal requirements
paragraphs: Florida has no official language law, but Miami's practical bilingualism creates AI design requirements that English-only AI systems don't satisfy — ClickMasters designs Miami consumer and healthcare AI for Spanish-English bilingual operation as a baseline.
